# xshield_aws_security_group_changes (Data Source)

Lists your own security groups that an approved Full control change applies to, in one account and region, when a Terraform pipeline delivers the account. Read it once, in the root module, and read `xshield_aws_security_group_rules` only for a group it lists: every other group keeps the rules its code declares, and its plan shows nothing from Xshield. It needs only the account and region, so it is read when the plan starts, even in a configuration that creates the VPC or the security groups it lists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read once per account and region, in the root module, and pass it to each group you route through Full control.
data "xshield_aws_security_group_changes" "this" {
  cloud_account_id = "123456789012"
  region           = "us-east-1"
}

module "web_rules" {
  source = "github.com/colortokens/terraform-provider-xshield//examples/enforcement-snapshot/modules/aws-security-group-rules?ref=vX.Y.Z"

  xshield_changes   = data.xshield_aws_security_group_changes.this
  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
  group_name        = aws_security_group.web.name
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.web.id

  ingress = {
    https_all  = { ip_protocol = "tcp", from_port = 443, to_port = 443, cidr_ipv4 = "0.0.0.0/0" }
    ssh_office = { ip_protocol = "tcp", from_port = 22, to_port = 22, cidr_ipv4 = "10.0.0.0/8" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) AWS account the groups are in.
- `region` (String) AWS region the groups are in.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Map of Set of String) Each group an approved change applies to, by its name, with the IDs of the VPCs it is in. A group not listed here keeps every rule its code declares.
- `published` (Boolean) False while Xshield has published nothing for this account and region; `groups` is then empty and `version` is null. Any other failure to read the changes fails the plan.
- `version` (String) Version of the changes to customer groups Xshield published for the account and region.
